name: 覆膜下旧声槽
pivotSuggestion: top-center for hanging pieces; contact top-center for terrain; center for landmarks
qaFindings: 骨壁被低饱和蓝灰旧膜覆盖，暗示的波槽尚不可清楚读出；无发光图案，后续显露态需清晰区分。
需root完成统一比例、透明深浅底和确定性房间合成验收；未作为已验收入库。

generationRequest.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated 2D game environment sprite on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, reference-guided redraw. Image1 supplies intended organ material and shape language; Image2 is the established delivered asset's matte gouache, clean dark ink contours, fine hand-painted texture and side-view only, do not copy its anatomy. Side-scrolling camera, very slight top-face visibility only where appropriate. Draw one complete coherent object with about 8% clear transparent padding, no scene, no floating multiple objects, no contact shadow or colored haze outside the silhouette. Full object uncropped. No characters, creatures, shelters, lamps, red ropes, rewards, symbols, labels, UI, ground patch, water or backdrop. No human stonework or invented portals.  Subject: ONE independent cranial bone wall fragment bearing old sound-memory grooves but currently COVERED by opaque aged membrane, R5 head landmark, 10 hero units wide. A broad irregular slightly curved ivory-blue bone plate, approximately 2.5:1 wide, with one diagonal natural crack near upper right. Its broad front face is covered by a dull desaturated blue-gray thin tissue film with a few wrinkle folds, so the old shallow long curved parallel sound grooves underneath are only barely hinted and unreadable. Outer bone border visible. Matte dark ink texture, non glowing, ancient quiet organic material. No literal whale drawing, no text, letters, runes or modern icon, no sound waves floating outside, no lamp, portal or platform. Same whole silhouette will be used for revealed state; generous transparent padding.

method: 内置 imagegen 逐件生成或参考引导静态状态修改；原始 PNG 未裁切、降噪或抠图。
